view.title: Map view
view.basemapHelp: Changes the colours, roads, labels, water, and land appearance.
view.albertaBoundaryHelp: Show or hide the provincial outline of Alberta.
view.defaultPoisHelp: Show or hide Alberta places available on every map.
view.modulePoisHelp: Show or hide locations for this learning module.
view.poiClusterRadiusHelp: Combine nearby markers within this screen distance. Select a group to zoom in and separate its points.
view.basemapPlacesHelp: Show or hide built-in icons and labels for businesses, parking, parks, and other places.

banff.description: Banff is a mountain town in Banff National Park, surrounded by the Canadian Rockies and connected by the Bow Valley.
banff.imageAlt: Illustration of a mountain lake and the Canadian Rockies near Banff; not a documentary photograph.

calgary.description: Calgary sits at the meeting of the Bow and Elbow rivers, where prairie meets the foothills.

dinosaurProvincialPark.description: Dinosaur Provincial Park preserves badlands landscapes and fossils. It is recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
dinosaurProvincialPark.imageAlt: Illustration of the Alberta badlands near Dinosaur Provincial Park; not a documentary photograph.

edmonton.description: Alberta's capital city sits along the North Saskatchewan River, whose valley forms a broad green corridor through the city.

jasper.description: Jasper is a mountain community in Jasper National Park and part of the Canadian Rocky Mountain Parks UNESCO World Heritage Site.

watertonLakes.description: Waterton Lakes National Park brings together prairie and mountain ecosystems at Alberta's southern border and forms part of Waterton-Glacier International Peace Park.
watertonLakes.imageAlt: Illustration of an alpine lake and mountain landscape in Waterton Lakes National Park; not a documentary photograph.
